# FIFO Pick Evidence

> Free, no-signup, no-upload tool that reads a warehouse pick-log CSV in your browser and reports FIFO pick-order exceptions and missing or ill-formed timestamps before a customer audit. Runs entirely client-side.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
